:::{#def-cv-choice}
#### Cross-validation choice procedure

Given candidate [fitting procedures](#def-fitting-procedure) $\candproc{1}, \ldots, \candproc{\ncand}$,
the **cross-validation choice procedure** $\candproctuned{\text{CV}}$
is the fitting procedure that,
applied to a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$,
divides $\trainset$ into $\nfolds$ [folds](#def-folds),
computes each candidate's [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate-indexed)
on $\trainset$ with those folds,
and applies to $\trainset$ the candidate with the smallest estimate,
taking the smallest $\icand$ if several tie:

$$
\candproctuned{\text{CV}}\paren{\trainset} \eqdef
\candfitted{\min \argmin_{\icand} \cvestof{\nfolds}{\candproc{\icand}}\paren{\trainset}}.
$$ {#eq-cv-choice}

:::
